text: Speaker 2 It was my first holiday without my parents and I was so excited about it. I travelled with a group of friends from college. We booked a holiday apartment to share the costs of the accommodation. Things started badly because we were delayed at the airport, but things got worse when we arrived at the apartment. The owner charged us a 200 pound deposit in case we damaged anything. We thought we had paid the full cost when we booked. Then we got ripped off everywhere we went. The restaurants, bars, even at the city ruins. I bought some souvenirs which were half the price everywhere else. I was in such a bad mood all week.
